title: Who used how much
intro: Tokens and sessions per person on your subscriptions – including the colleagues and agents who share the subscriptions you switched on for them. Numbers only, no content.
range.invalid: Please choose a valid period of at most {days} days.
load-failed: The usage could not be loaded: {reason}
empty: Nobody used a subscription in this period.
foreign.note: Another person's subscription: you see your own use only.
measured.none: No measurement of this window – the share of the quota cannot be estimated.
measured.range: The provider measures no quota for a chosen period – only tokens are shown.
estimate.note: Anthropic measures the quota per subscription only, not per person. A person's share is their share of all tokens on this subscription in the same window times the measured use – an estimate.
dfx.title: Usage through DFX access
dfx.intro: What ran through DFX access is taken from the organization's credit (last 30 days, per person).
